entities.summary: Kevin Troy Faulk is an American former professional football running back who played in the National Football League (NFL) for 13 seasons with the New England Patriots. Faulk played college football for the LSU Tigers, winning SEC Freshman of the Year in 1995 and receiving first-team All-American honors the following season. He was selected by the Patriots in the second round of the 1999 NFL draft.
